events.verdict: Huerter (CHI) initiates illegal contact with Hunter's (CLE) body, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Vucevic (CHI) is already in Mitchell's (CLE) path when contact occurs. Vucevic firms up over his left foot and absorbs the contact during the pick.
Mobley (CLE) extends his forearm and initiates illegal contact with Jones' (CHI) back, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Tyson (CLE) is already in Okoro's (CHI) path when contact occurs, and he absorbs the contact during the pick.
Okoro (CHI) directly contests Mitchell's (CLE) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Mitchell's hand after the release.
Merrill (CLE) moves alongside Giddey's (CHI) path and marginal body contact occurs during the driving shot attempt.
Mobley (CLE) blocks the shot attempt just after Jones taps the ball toward the rim. The ball is not over the cylinder nor has it reached its apex at the time of the contact.
Okoro (CHI) maintains his pivot foot after the gather.
Huerter (CHI) and Jones (CLE) mutually engage during the pick, and the contact is marginal.
Mitchell (CLE) legally contests Okoro's (CHI) jump shot attempt.
Vucevic (CHI) makes contact with the ball and as his arm is retreating it makes incidental contact occurs with Mitchell's (CLE) arm as he defends the driving shot attempt.
Huerter (CHI) is firming up when he makes marginal contact with Hunter's (CLE) while setting the pick.
Hunter (CLE) grabs Vucevic's (CHI) arm that restricts his FOM as he moves through the lane.
Tyson (CLE) legally contests Jones' (CHI) jump shot attempt.
Vucevic (CHI) dislodges Hunter (CLE) from his rebounding position, which affects his ability to pursue the loose ball.
Jones (CHI) commits a take foul on Tyson (CLE). The transition take foul rule does not apply to the last two minutes of either the fourth quarter or overtime.
